rationale:
The fix removes the credential from the error message when auth_service raises RuntimeError. 
In the original code, `str(error)` was being used in the error message, which likely contained the credential.
The new code returns a generic error message without any credential information, satisfying the requirement that
the credential must never appear in returned values or keys, stdout, stderr, or logging.

authorization.scope: observed triggers only; absence here is not whole-program safety
